description: This PHP source file defines the 'Authorize' controller class within the Opencart e-commerce platform's admin mail namespace. The class handles authorization-related email notifications and reset functionalities, including sending authorization emails and processing reset requests.

classes.name: Authorize
classes.description: An admin controller class responsible for handling authorization and reset email notifications within the Opencart platform.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Handles the process of sending an authorization email if a session code exists, including preparing email data and scheduling the email task.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Manages reset requests, particularly for authorization, by preparing and scheduling reset email tasks.
